title: अंश ५ · अध्याय १७

items.text:
अक्रूरोऽपि विनिष्कम्य स्यन्दनेनाशुगामिना ।
कृष्णसन्दर्शनायैकः प्रययौ नन्दगोकुलम् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
akrūro'pi viniṣkamya syandanenāśugāminā |
kṛṣṇasandarśanāyaikaḥ prayayau nandagokulam || 1 ||

items.text:
चिन्तयामास चाक्रूरो नास्ति धन्यतरो मया ।
योऽहमंशावतीर्णास्य मुखं द्रक्ष्यामि चक्रिणः ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
cintayāmāsa cākrūro nāsti dhanyataro mayā |
yo'hamaṃśāvatīrṇāsya mukhaṃ drakṣyāmi cakriṇaḥ || 2 ||

items.text:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म सुप्रभाता च मे निशा ।
यदुन्नदाब्जपत्राक्षं विष्णोद्र क्ष्याम्यहं मुखम् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
adya me saphalaṃ janma suprabhātā ca me niśā |
yadunnadābjapatrākṣaṃ viṣṇodra kṣyāmyahaṃ mukham || 3 ||

items.text:
अद्य मे सफले नेत्रे अद्य मे सफला गिरः ।
यन्मे परस्परालापो दृष्ट्वां विष्णुं भविष्यति ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
adya me saphale netre adya me saphalā giraḥ |
yanme parasparālāpo dṛṣṭvāṃ viṣṇuṃ bhaviṣyati || 4 ||

items.text:
पापं हरति यत् पुंसां स्मृतं सङ्कल्पनामयम् ।
तत् पुण्डरीकनयनं विष्णोद्र क्ष्याम्यहं मुखम् ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
pāpaṃ harati yat puṃsāṃ smṛtaṃ saṅkalpanāmayam |
tat puṇḍarīkanayanaṃ viṣṇodra kṣyāmyahaṃ mukham || 5 ||

items.text:
निर्जग्मुश्व यतो वेदा वेदाङ्गन्यखिलानि च ।
द्रक्ष्यामि तत्प्रं धाम धाम्रां भगवतो मुखम् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
nirjagmuśva yato vedā vedāṅganyakhilāni ca |
drakṣyāmi tatpraṃ dhāma dhāmrāṃ bhagavato mukham || 6 ||

items.text:
यज्ञेषु यज्ञपुरुषः पुरुषैः पुरुषोत्तमः ।
इच्यते योऽखिलाधारस्तं द्रक्ष्यामि जगत्पातिम ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
yajñeṣu yajñapuruṣaḥ puruṣaiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
icyate yo'khilādhārastaṃ drakṣyāmi jagatpātima || 7 ||

items.text:
इष्ट्वा यमिन्द्रो यज्ञानां शतेनामरराजताम् ।
अवाप तमन्नादिमहं द्रक्ष्यामि केशवम् ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
iṣṭvā yamindro yajñānāṃ śatenāmararājatām |
avāpa tamannādimahaṃ drakṣyāmi keśavam || 8 ||

items.text:
न ब्रह्मा नेन्द्र-रुद्रा-श्वि-वस्वा-दित्य-मरुदूगणाः ।
यस्य स्वरूपं जानन्ति स्प्रक्ष्यत्यङ्ग स मे हरिः ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
na brahmā nendra-rudrā-śvi-vasvā-ditya-marudūgaṇāḥ |
yasya svarūpaṃ jānanti sprakṣyatyaṅga sa me hariḥ || 9 ||

items.text:
सर्व्वात्मा सर्व्ववित् सर्व्वः सर्व्वभूतेष्ववस्थितः ।
यो वितत्यात्ययो व्यापी स वक्ष्यति मया सह ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
sarvvātmā sarvvavit sarvvaḥ sarvvabhūteṣvavasthitaḥ |
yo vitatyātyayo vyāpī sa vakṣyati mayā saha || 10 ||

items.text:
मत्स्य-कूर्म-पराहा-श्व-सिंहरूपादिभिः स्थितिम् ।
चकार जगतो योऽजः सोऽद्य मामालपिष्यति ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
matsya-kūrma-parāhā-śva-siṃharūpādibhiḥ sthitim |
cakāra jagato yo'jaḥ so'dya māmālapiṣyati || 11 ||

items.text:
साम्प्रतञ्च जगत्स्वामी कार्य्यमात्मह्टदि स्थितम् ।
कर्त्तु मनुष्यतां प्राप्तः स्वेच्छादेहधृगव्ययः ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
sāmpratañca jagatsvāmī kāryyamātmahṭadi sthitam |
karttu manuṣyatāṃ prāptaḥ svecchādehadhṛgavyayaḥ || 12 ||

items.text:
योऽनन्तः पृथिवीं धत्ते शेखरस्थितिसंस्थिताम् ।
सोऽवतीर्णो जगत्यर्थे मामक्रूरेति वक्ष्यति ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
yo'nantaḥ pṛthivīṃ dhatte śekharasthitisaṃsthitām |
so'vatīrṇo jagatyarthe māmakrūreti vakṣyati || 13 ||

items.text:
पितृ-पुत्र-सुह्टदू-भ्रातृ-मातृ-बन्धुमयीमिमाम् ।
यन्मायां नालमुत्तर्त्तु जगत् नमो नमः ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
pitṛ-putra-suhṭadū-bhrātṛ-mātṛ-bandhumayīmimām |
yanmāyāṃ nālamuttarttu jagat namo namaḥ || 14 ||

items.text:
तरत्यविद्यां विततां ह्टदि यस्मिन् निवेशिते ।
योगी मायाममेयाय तस्मै विद्यात्मने नमः ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
taratyavidyāṃ vitatāṃ hṭadi yasmin niveśite |
yogī māyāmameyāya tasmai vidyātmane namaḥ || 15 ||

items.text:
यज्विभिर्यज्ञपुरुषो वासुदेवश्व सात्वतैः ।
वेदान्तवेदिभिर्विष्णुः प्रोच्यते यो नतोऽस्मि तम् ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
yajvibhiryajñapuruṣo vāsudevaśva sātvataiḥ |
vedāntavedibhirviṣṇuḥ procyate yo nato'smi tam || 16 ||

items.text:
यथा तत्र जगद्धाम्रि धातर्य्योतत् प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
सदसत् तेन सत्येन मय्यसौ यातु सौम्यताम् ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
yathā tatra jagaddhāmri dhātaryyotat pratiṣṭhitam |
sadasat tena satyena mayyasau yātu saumyatām || 17 ||

items.text:
स्मृते सकलकल्याण-भाजनं यत्र जायते ।
पुरुषस्तमजं नित्यं व्रजामि शरणं हरिम् ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
smṛte sakalakalyāṇa-bhājanaṃ yatra jāyate |
puruṣastamajaṃ nityaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ harim || 18 ||

items.text:
इत्थं सञ्चिन्तयन् विष्णु भक्तिनम्रात्ममानसः ।
अक्रूरो गोकुल प्राप्तः किञ्चित् सूर्य्ये विराजति ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
itthaṃ sañcintayan viṣṇu bhaktinamrātmamānasaḥ |
akrūro gokula prāptaḥ kiñcit sūryye virājati || 19 ||

items.text:
स ददर्श तदा तत्र कृष्णामादोहने गवाम् ।
वत्समध्यगतं फुल्लनीलोतूपलदलच्छविम् ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
sa dadarśa tadā tatra kṛṣṇāmādohane gavām |
vatsamadhyagataṃ phullanīlotūpaladalacchavim || 20 ||

items.text:
अस्पष्टपद्मपत्राक्षं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम ।
प्रलम्बबाहुमायामि-तुङ्गोरःस्थलमुन्नसम् ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
aspaṣṭapadmapatrākṣaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasama |
pralambabāhumāyāmi-tuṅgoraḥsthalamunnasam || 21 ||

items.text:
सविलासस्मिताधारं ब्रिभ्राणं मुखपङ्कजम् ।
तुङ्गरक्तनखं पद्भयां धरण्यां सुप्रतिष्ठितम् ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
savilāsasmitādhāraṃ bribhrāṇaṃ mukhapaṅkajam |
tuṅgaraktanakhaṃ padbhayāṃ dharaṇyāṃ supratiṣṭhitam || 22 ||

items.text:
विभ्राणं वाससी पीते वन्यपुष्पावभूषितम् ।
साद्रनीललताहस्तं सिताम्भोजावतंसकम् ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
vibhrāṇaṃ vāsasī pīte vanyapuṣpāvabhūṣitam |
sādranīlalatāhastaṃ sitāmbhojāvataṃsakam || 23 ||

items.text:
हंसकुन्देन्दुधवल नीलाम्बरधरं द्रिज!
तस्यानु बलभद्रञ्च ददर्श यदुनन्दनम् ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
haṃsakundendudhavala nīlāmbaradharaṃ drija!
tasyānu balabhadrañca dadarśa yadunandanam || 24 ||

items.text:
प्राशुमुन्नतबाह्व सं विकाशिमुखपङ्कजम् ।
मेघमालापरिवृतं कैलासद्रिमिवापरम् ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
prāśumunnatabāhva saṃ vikāśimukhapaṅkajam |
meghamālāparivṛtaṃ kailāsadrimivāparam || 25 ||

items.text:
तौ दृष्ट्वा विकसदूक्तसरोजः स महामतिः ।
पुलकाञ्चितसर्व्वाङ्गस्तदाक्रू रोऽभवन्मुने ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
tau dṛṣṭvā vikasadūktasarojaḥ sa mahāmatiḥ |
pulakāñcitasarvvāṅgastadākrū ro'bhavanmune || 26 ||

items.text:
एतत् तत् परमं घाम तदेतत् परमं पदम् ।
भगवद्रासुदेवांशो द्रिधा योऽयमवस्थितः ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
etat tat paramaṃ ghāma tadetat paramaṃ padam |
bhagavadrāsudevāṃśo dridhā yo'yamavasthitaḥ || 27 ||

items.text:
साफल्यमक्ष्णोर्युगमेतदत्र दृष्टे जगद्धातरि यातमुच्चेः ।
अप्यङ्गमेतदू भगवतूप्रसादांदू दत्तेऽङ्गसङ्ग फलवन्मम स्यात ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
sāphalyamakṣṇoryugametadatra dṛṣṭe jagaddhātari yātamucceḥ |
apyaṅgametadū bhagavatūprasādāṃdū datte'ṅgasaṅga phalavanmama syāta || 28 ||

items.text:
अप्येष पूष्ठे मम हस्तपद्म करिष्यति श्रीमदनन्तमूर्त्तिः ।
यस्याङ्ग लिस्पर्शहताखिलाघैखाप्यते सिद्धिरनाशदोषा ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
apyeṣa pūṣṭhe mama hastapadma kariṣyati śrīmadanantamūrttiḥ |
yasyāṅga lisparśahatākhilāghaikhāpyate siddhiranāśadoṣā || 29 ||

items.text: येनाग्रिविद्यु दूरविरश्मिमाला करालमत्युग्रनानां नयनाञ्जनानि ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr: yenāgrividyu dūraviraśmimālā karālamatyugranānāṃ nayanāñjanāni || 30 ||

items.text:
यत्राम्बु विन्यस्य बलिर्म्मनोज्ञा नवाप भोगान् वसुधातलस्थः ।
तथामरत्वं त्रिदशाधिपत्यं मन्वन्तरं पूर्णमपेतशत्रुः ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
yatrāmbu vinyasya balirmmanojñā navāpa bhogān vasudhātalasthaḥ |
tathāmaratvaṃ tridaśādhipatyaṃ manvantaraṃ pūrṇamapetaśatruḥ || 31 ||

items.text:
अप्येष मां कंसपरिग्रहेण दोषास्पदीभूतमदोषदुष्टम् ।
कर्त्तावमानोपहतं धिगस्तु तज्जन्मनः साधुबहिष्कृतं यत् ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
apyeṣa māṃ kaṃsaparigraheṇa doṣāspadībhūtamadoṣaduṣṭam |
karttāvamānopahataṃ dhigastu tajjanmanaḥ sādhubahiṣkṛtaṃ yat || 32 ||

items.text:
ज्ञानात्मकस्यामलसत्त्वराशेरपेतदोषस्य सदा स्फुटस्य
किं वा जगत्यत्र समस्तपुंसामज्ञातमस्यास्ति ह्टदि स्थितस्य ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
jñānātmakasyāmalasattvarāśerapetadoṣasya sadā sphuṭasya
kiṃ vā jagatyatra samastapuṃsāmajñātamasyāsti hṭadi sthitasya || 33 ||

items.text:
तस्मादहं भक्तिविनम्रचेता व्रजामि सर्व्वेश्वरमीश्वराणाम् ।
अंशावतारं पुरुषोत्तमस्य अनादिमध्यान्तमयस्य विष्णोः ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
tasmādahaṃ bhaktivinamracetā vrajāmi sarvveśvaramīśvarāṇām |
aṃśāvatāraṃ puruṣottamasya anādimadhyāntamayasya viṣṇoḥ || 34 ||

en_chapter: Parāçara said:—Having issued out of the house of Kansa, Akrurā being desirous of seeing Krishna, proceeded towards the house of Nanda in a swift-coursing car. He thought within himself. "There is none more fortunate than I, for I shall behold the countenance of a portion of the holder of discus. To-day my life has borne fruit, my night is followed by the dawn of day, for I shall behold the countenance of Vishnu resembling full-blown lotuses. Blessed are my eyes and blessed are my words, for on beholding Vishnu a conversation shall take place between him and me. I shall behold the countenance of Vishnu having lotus eyes, which, when seen only in imagination, removes all sins. I shall behold to-day the mouth of Vishnu—the glory of glories, whence proceeded the Vedas and all their divisions. I shall behold the lord of the universe by whom the world is sustained, who is worshipped as the best Purusha and as the male of sacrifice in sacrificial rites. I shall behold Keseva, who is without beginning or end, by worshipping whom with a hundred sacrifices, Indra obtained the sovereignty over the celestials. That Hari, whose nature is unknown to Brahmā, Indra, Rudra, the Aswins, the Vasus, the Adityas and Maruts, will this day touch my body. He, who is the soul of all omniscient, is identical with everything, omnipresent, permanent, undecaying, all-pervading, shall converse with me. He, the unborn, who has preserved the world in diverse forms of a fish, a tortoise, a boar, a horse, a lion, will this day talk with me. The lord of the universe, who assumes shapes at will, has taken upon him the condition of humanity to satisfy some object of his heart. The endless, who holds the earth upon his crest and who has descended upon earth for its protection, will this day call me by my name. Glory to that being, whose deceptive adoption of father, son, brother, friend, mother, and relative, the world is unable to comprehend. Salutation unto him, who is identical with true knowledge, who is inscrutable and through whom, when seated in his heart the ascetic gets over the worldly ignorance and illusion, I bow to him, who, by the performers of holy rites, is denominated Yajnapurusha (the male of a sacrifice), Vāsudeva, by the devotees and Vishnu by the adepts in Vedānta philosophy. May he, who comprises in himself, cause and effect and the world itself, be pleased with me, through his truth, for I always confide in that unborn and eternal Hari, by meditating on whom man becomes the repository of all auspicious things".

Parāçara said:—Thus meditating upon Vishnu, Akrura, having his mind animated by devout faith, reached Gokula a little before sun-set; and there he beheld Krishna amongst the cattle, dark as the leaf of the full-blown lotus; his eyes of the same colour and his breast adorned with Srivatsa mark; long-armed, broad-chested; having a high nose, a graceful countenance with smiles; treading firmly on the ground with feet whose nails were tinted red; dressed in yellow raiments and be-decked with a garland of forest flowers; having a creeper just collected in his hands, and a chaplet of white lotus-flowers on his head. Akrura also saw there Balabhadra, white as a jasmine, a swan or the moon dressed in a blue dress; having large and mighty arms and a countenance as radiant as a blue lotus, like the Kailāsa mountain adorned with a wreath of clouds.

When Akrura, beheld these two young men, his countenance expanded with joy and the down of his body stood erect with delight. And he thought—"This is the supreme happiness and repository; this the double manifestation of the divine Vāsudeva; blessed are my eyes for I have seen the protector of the universe and my bodily form shall yield fruit, when by the favour of the deity it shall come in contact with his person. Shall that assumer of infinite forms place his hand on my back by the touch of whose fingers alone all sins are dispelled and imperishable, felicity is secured. And by this hand holding the fierce irresistible discus blazing with all the flames of fire, lightning, and the sun, were slain the Daitya chiefs, and the collyrium from the eyes of their females was washed. Into this hand Bali poured water and obtained enjoyments in the region under the earth and immortality and dominion over the celestials for a whole Manwantara without danger from any enemy. Although I am not sinful, perhaps he will despise me for my connection with the vicious Kansa. If so, cursed is my birth who is counted amongst the wicked. What is there unknown to him who resides in the hearts of all men, who is ever existent, freed from imperfection, the aggregate of the quality of purity and at one with true knowledge? With a heart animated with devout faith I approach the lord of lords, the descended portion of that excellent Purusha, Vishnu, who his without beginning, middle or end".
